text.description_html:
Acorn BH2xI-6, Top Mount Sliding Barn Door Installation Kit with 6' Track

The Barn Door style Flat Track Rolling Hardware comes with everything you need to install a 3 foot sliding door. It is available in a variety of colors including traditional black, and more unique colors like red and yellow. No matter which of the powder-coat options you choose, installing a barn door is a great way to ambiance to any room. This top mount carrier is designed to use on most doors under 250 lbs.

Features of the Acorn BH2xI-6, Barn Door Hardware with Rounded Wheel Carriers Ends:

  • Kit package includes everything you need to install a barn door.
  • Anti-jump track blocks.
  • Available in 8 brilliant colors.

Specifications of the Barn Door Kit with 6' Track:

  • Mount Length: 4"
  • Mount Width: 5-1/4"
  • Track: 6 feet (72 inches)
  • For doors up to 3 feet (36 inches)
  • For wood doors up to 250 lbs.
  • Package Includes: 6' track, wheel Carriers, standoffs, end stops, anti jump blocks, and door bottom stabilizers.

In case of a doorway larger than 3 feet, custom length tracks are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Finish option Flat Black is in stock for immediate shipment. Please Contact Us for current estimated delivery times on all other finishes. All other finishes are special order and NOT RETURNABLE.
